Final for Publication
File No. 23000T1

TYPE 1 ZONING MAP AMENDMENT
Substitute Narrative, Analysis, and Plans
854 West Wrightwood Avenue
RT-4 District to RM-5 District (Type 1)

854 W Wrightwood LLC is the “Applicant” for a Type 1 Zoning Map Amendment for the subject property
located at 854 West Wrightwood Avenue from the RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-
Unit District to the RM-5 Residential Multi-Unit District to renovate the existing multi-unit residential

building at the subject property.

The subject property is located on the block bounded by West Schubert Avenue on the north, North
Dayton Street on the east, West Wrightwood Avenue on the south, and North Mildred Avenue on the
west. The subject property contains approximately 4,000 square feet of site area and is improved with
an approximately 137-year-old multi-unit residential building with vinyl rear addition containing five
dwelling units, an unfinished basement, and a detached garage with one vehicular parking space.

The Applicant proposes to preserve the historic exterior of the existing building, reconstruct the rear
addition, and renovate the interior of the building to modernize the units and provide three additional
dwelling units, construct a rear attached deck with private balconies; and replace the existing garage
with a new detached three-car garage with a rooftop deck. The existing building measures 36.1 feet
in height and will contain a total of eight dwelling units (five existing units and three new units), three
vehicular parking spaces, three bicycle parking spaces, and no commercial space. The overall FAR
will be 1.52. The Applicant seeks all relief necessary, as allowed by the Chicago Zoning Ordinance,
for the attached plans.

*Pursuant to Section 17-13-0303-D of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, as part of this Type 1 Zoning
Map Amendment, the Applicant seeks: (1) an administrative adjustment to reduce the required rear
yard open space from 210 square feet to 0 square feet; and variations (2) to reduce the required front
yard setback from 9.63 feet to 4.16 feet; (3) to reduce the required rear yard setback from 37.5 feet to
34.83 feet; (4) to reduce the required east side yard setback from 2.56 feet to 0.0 feet; (5) to reduce
the required west side yard setback from 2.56 feet to 1.0 feet; and (6) to reduce the required combined
side yard setback from 6.4 feet to 1.0 feet.
